transcript.content: Cluster 87's top up-regulated markers are: hes2.2, hes6, rrm1, atoh7, pcna, insm1a, hes2.1, ccnd1. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: proliferating retinal progenitor / retinal stem-progenitor cell in the ciliary marginal zone, with neurogenic atoh7⁺ bias.**

## Evidence
- **atoh7** — curated expression in retina and ciliary marginal zone; also retinal ganglion-cell layer, consistent with neurogenic retinal progenitors/RGC-lineage bias [record](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000926-1/expression).  
- **ccnd1** — expressed in immature eye/retina and curated in ciliary marginal zone; gene function includes regulation of neural retina development and eye morphogenesis [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-176).  
- **pcna** — proliferation/DNA-replication marker; ZFIN places it in immature eye/nervous system, and GO/InterPro supports DNA polymerase processivity factor activity / regulation of DNA replication [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000210-8), [record](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/protein/reviewed/P12004/).  
- **hes6** — bHLH transcription factor expressed in retina/optic vesicle; compatible with retinal neurodevelopmental/progenitor programs [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030828-5/expression).  
- **hes2.2** — predicted transcriptional regulator involved in regulation of neurogenesis; expressed in eye [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-060825-55).  
- **insm1a** — curated retinal expression and retinal regenerating/Müller-cell contexts; supports neural/retinal differentiation rather than a non-retinal lineage [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1810/expression).  
- **ciliary marginal zone** — ZFA defines this as a proliferative retinal periphery where retinal stem cells are located, source of most retinal growth after 60 hpf [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001289).  

## Caveats
- **atoh7** can indicate retinal ganglion-cell fate, but strong **pcna/ccnd1/rrm1**-type cycling signal argues progenitor, not mature RGC.
- Without down-regulated markers, mature retinal subtype exclusion is limited.

**Verdict:** retinal progenitor cell, cycling — confidence medium

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Most defensible: proliferating retinal neuroblast / retinal progenitor, biased toward atoh7⁺ retinal ganglion-cell lineage; alternative: generic cycling neural progenitor / CMZ-like retinal stem-progenitor.**

## Evidence
- **atoh7** — strongest identity anchor: curated expression in **retina**, **ciliary marginal zone**, and **retinal ganglion cell layer**; ZFA lists atoh7 among top genes for **retinal ganglion cell**, whose axons form the optic nerve. This favors RGC-lineage neuroblast over a generic proliferative cell. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/action/marker/ZDB-GENE-000926-1/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **insm1a** — supports neuronal/retinal differentiation rather than pure stemness: ZFIN expression includes **retina**, **presumptive neural retina**, and **Muller cell/regenerating retina** contexts; curated publication links insm1a to photoreceptor differentiation, so it is not RGC-specific. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1810/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **pcna / rrm1** — proliferation/S-phase signal: pcna is expressed in immature eye/nervous system and GO-associated with DNA replication machinery; this supports **cycling/progenitor state**, not mature neurons. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000210-8?utm_source=openai))
- **ccnd1** — cycling retinal progenitor support: ZFIN annotates roles in camera-type eye morphogenesis and regulation of neural retina development; ccnd1 expression is reported in **ciliary marginal zone**, a retinal growth/progenitor region. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-176?utm_source=openai))
- **hes6 / hes2.1 / hes2.2** — bHLH/Notch-neurogenesis context: hes6 is expressed in eye/optic vesicle and acts in transcriptional regulation, but it is not sufficient alone for a retinal cell-type call. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030828-5?utm_source=openai))
- **ZFA retina/CMZ frame** — retina is the optic-cup-derived structure containing retinal neural layer and RPE; CMZ literature records actively proliferating retinal stem cells generating retinal neurons, matching cycling retinal progenitors. ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000152?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Alternative **lateral-line/pro-neural sensory progenitor** is weakened: insm1a can mark posterior lateral line, but atoh7 plus ccnd1/pcna retina/CMZ evidence points deeper to retina.
- Deepest defensible tier: **retinal neuroblast/progenitor**, not mature RGC.

**Verdict:** retinal neuroblast / retinal progenitor, cycling — confidence medium
